items.titleEn: Date confirmed for Carabao Cup trip to Fleetwood
items.summaryEn: We will face the League Two side in the next round of the competition
bodyEn: We have been drawn against Fleetwood Town in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup, with the tie to take place at the League Two side's Highbury Stadium on Tuesday, October 27.
The game will kick off at 8pm and be broadcast in the UK on Sky Sports.
After beating Ipswich Town 4-2 at Portman Road on Tuesday to advance in the competition, we will now face the Fishermen in what will be the first-ever competitive meeting between the sides.

Fleetwood reached this stage by beating fellow fourth-tier opposition Chesterfield and Shrewsbury Town, before then knocking out Championship side Sheffield United in the third round. All of their ties have been held at their 5,300-capacity home in the north-west.

We reached the final last season before Manchester City pipped us to the silverware at Wembley, missing out on having our name engraved on the trophy for a third time, with our two successes coming in 1987 and 1993.
Ticket information will be announced in due course.

items.titleZh: 联赛杯客场对阵弗利特伍德的比赛日期确定
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳将在下一轮联赛杯中客场对阵英乙球队弗利特伍德。
bodyZh: 我们在联赛杯第四轮抽到了弗利特伍德镇，比赛将于10月27日星期二在这支英乙球队的高地伯里球场进行。
比赛将于晚上8点开球，并在英国的天空体育台进行转播。
周二我们在波特曼路球场以4比2击败伊普斯维ッチ晋级后，接下来将对阵这支绰号为“渔夫”的球队，这也将是两队历史上的首次正式交锋。
弗利特伍德通过击败同属第四级别的切斯特菲尔德和什鲁斯伯里晋级到本阶段，随后在第三轮淘汰了英冠球队谢菲尔德联。他们所有的比赛都在西北部这座容量为5,300人的主场进行。
我们在上赛季打入决赛，但在温布利被曼城击败与冠军擦肩而过，未能第三次将队名刻在奖杯上。我们此前的两次夺冠分别是在1987年和1993年。
球票相关信息将择日公布。

items.summaryEn: The best of the action from our five-star performance in Norfolk
bodyEn: Our young Gunners made it three U18 Premier League South wins in a row after thrashing Norwich City 5-1 at the Avant Training Centre.
The game was won in the first half, as Axel Donczew, Charlie Purdy and a brace from Jaden Maghoma put us four goals up before the break.
The Canaries pulled one back through Ollie Roberson, but Emerson Nwaneri struck with seconds to spare to ensure we ended the afternoon in style.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳青年队客场5比1大胜诺维奇城，取得U18英超南部联赛三连胜。
bodyZh: 在阿旺特训练中心以5比1大胜诺维奇城后，我们的年轻枪手们取得了U18英超南部联赛的三连胜。

金丝雀由奥利·罗伯逊扳回一城，但埃默森·恩瓦内里在比赛即将结束前破门，确保我们以完美的方式结束了这个下午。

items.titleEn: Smilla: “We have to keep working hard”
items.summaryEn: Smilla Holmberg says attention turns to the training pitch, where we’ll be looking to right the wrongs of our last two Women’s Super League draws at Emirates Stadium.
bodyEn: Smilla Holmberg says attention turns to the training pitch, where we’ll be looking to right the wrongs of our last two Women’s Super League draws at Emirates Stadium.
It was our Swedish right back who got the 95th-minute equaliser against Manchester United on Saturday evening, but she was disappointed our efforts could only count for one point.

“Of course, not good enough,” she said after the game. “We want to win every game, especially here at Emirates. This was an important game to bounce back from the last game. It was tough today, but it wasn't good enough really.
“I think the fans were amazing, incredible. So yeah, just disappointed that we couldn't do better.”
We’ve had so much of the ball and created so many chances in the last two matches, so can Smilla put her finger on why we’re not finding the back of the net much?

“That's a good question,” she said. “When you play for Arsenal, you want to win these types of games, so you want to score a lot of goals. We have to keep working hard, and we know what this group is capable of doing. Just keep working hard and see what we can do better.

“[The message when I came on was] just bring the energy. We want to win the game, and unfortunately we couldn't win the game today. Just communicate and bring the energy. So yes, unfortunately we couldn't get to win today, so disappointed. Now we have to regroup and focus on Tuesday.

“It’s incredible to play at Emirates and to score here at Emirates, in front of family and around 30,000 here, so incredible of course. Just disappointed that we couldn't give three points back to them.”
items.author: Stephen Wright
items.titleZh: 斯米拉：“我们必须继续努力工作”
items.summaryZh: 斯米拉·霍姆贝格表示球队将重返训练场，力求在酋长球场修正前两场英超联赛平局的错误。
bodyZh: 斯米拉·霍姆贝格表示球队将重返训练场，力求在酋长球场修正前两场女子英超联赛平局的错误。
正是这位瑞典右后卫在周六晚对阵曼联的比赛中于第95分钟攻入扳平一球，但她对球队的努力最终只换来一分感到失望。
她在赛后表示：“当然，这还不够好。我们想要赢得每一场比赛，特别是在酋长球场这里。这是一场需要从上一场比赛中反弹的重要比赛。今天的比赛很艰难，但实际上还不够好。”
“我认为球迷们太棒了，简直不可思议。所以是的，只是感到失望，我们本可以做得更好。”
我们在过去两场比赛中控制了大量球权并创造了许多机会，斯米拉能否指出我们进球不多的原因？
她说道：“这是一个好问题。当你为阿森纳效力时，你想要赢得这类比赛，所以你想要打进很多球。我们必须继续努力工作，我们知道这支团队有能力做到什么。只需继续努力工作，看看我们能做得更好。”
“（我上场时的指令是）带来活力。我们想要赢得比赛，但不幸的是我们今天没能赢得比赛。只需沟通并带来活力。所以是的，不幸的是我们今天未能取胜，感到很失望。现在我们必须重新集结，把注意力集中在周二。”
“在酋长球场踢球并在这里进球，在家人和大约3万名观众面前，这当然是不可思议的。只是很失望没能把三分回馈给他们。”

items.titleEn: Renée: “We wanted to be more clinical”
items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers shares her thoughts on Saturday's 1-1 draw at home to Manchester United in the Women's Super League
bodyEn: Following last weekend’s 0-0 draw against Crystal Palace, the objective against Manchester United was clear: convert more of our chances.
We were only able to do that on one late occasion in Saturday’s 1-1 draw at Emirates Stadium though, with our head coach left wanted the side to become more clinical.

“I think there was domination on the pitch, I think in the first half they spent more time on the ball than we would have wanted, so we got more aggressive in the second half,” Renée Slegers said. “I think they have very little opportunities. Of course, the chance that they get is a very open chance, which they capitalised on.

“I think going into the game we wanted to be more clinical, we wanted to be ruthless with our opportunities in the box, but unfortunately we couldn't convert the dominance in the final third into goals today.

“From a mentality perspective, what the players did at the end of the game, with the energy and the ideas of the five game changers that come on, that's definitely something we're going to take with us. It gives us belief that we can do things late in the game, but of course we wanted three points today.”

Smilla Holmberg was one of those game changers, getting in an advanced position on the right to bury Leah Williamson’s 95th-minute cross, but naturally the boss wants more goals to show for our chance creation.

“I think we have our box entries, we have our shots and there’s quite some that go on target,” she said. “We just have to continue to work on being more dangerous in front of goal and that's a collective responsibility. That's something we do together, of course, because we really believe in the quality of the squad, the qualities of the players.
“We believe that if those final details are going to be there and things start clicking, we're going to be good.”
We have a period of big games coming up, starting with Tuesday’s UEFA Women’s Champions League opener against HB Koge in Borehamwood.

“Recover now and then a couple of days to work towards Koge,” Renée added. “I think that's good for us. Of course, we're going to be reviewing this performance and take all the learnings so we're effective with our training week.

“Then we look forward to being in front of the fans again because what they did for us today, I said the five game changers, but also the crowd here helping us towards that goal, that was amazing. We really want to pay back to the fans and let's start on Tuesday.”
items.author: Stephen Wright
items.titleZh: 雷妮：我们希望在门前更具杀手本色
items.summaryZh: 雷妮·斯勒格斯谈论了周六女超联赛主场1比1战平曼联的比赛。
bodyZh: 在上周末对阵水晶宫以0比0战平之后，本场对阵曼联的目标非常明确：把握住更多得分机会。
不过在周六于酋长球场进行的1比1平局中，我们直到比赛尾声才抓住了一次机会，主教练赛后坦言希望球队在门前表现得更加果断。
雷妮·斯勒格斯表示：“我认为我们在场上占据了统治地位，上半场他们控球的时间比我们预想的要多，所以在下半场我们增强了侵略性。我认为他们获得的良机非常少。当然，他们得到的机会是一个非常好的单刀机会，并且他们把握住了。”
“我认为在赛前我们希望更具杀手本色，希望在禁区内的机会面前毫不留情，但遗憾的是，我们今天没能把进攻三区的统治力转化为进球。”
“从心态的角度来看，球员们在比赛最后阶段展现出的活力，以及替补上场的五名球员带来的能量和战术思路，绝对是我们会带走的收获。这让我们坚信我们能在比赛最后阶段创造奇迹，但当然我们今天想要的是三分。”
斯米拉·霍姆贝里（Smilla Holmberg）正是其中一名改变比赛的球员，她在右路前插，将莉亚·威廉姆森（Leah Williamson）在第95分钟的传中打进，不过主教练自然希望我们创造的机会能转化为更多进球。
她说：“我认为我们有进入禁区的机会，有射门，其中有不少也射正了。我们只需继续努力在球门前更具威胁，这是一项集体责任。这是我们共同去做的事情，当然，因为我们真的坚信球队的实力以及球员们的素质。”
“我们相信，如果那些最后的细节能够到位，并且事情开始顺理成章，我们会表现出色的。”
接下来我们将迎来一系列重要比赛，首先是周二在博勒姆伍德进行的对阵HB克厄的欧洲女足冠军联赛首场比赛。
雷妮补充道：“现在先进行恢复，然后用几天时间为对阵克厄做准备。我认为这对我门有好处。当然，我们将回顾这场表现并汲取所有经验教训，以便在训练周中保持高效。”
“然后我们期待再次在球迷面前比赛，因为他们今天为我们所做的一切——我提到了那五名替补球员，但这里的球迷也帮助我们打入了那个进球，这太棒了。我们真的很想回报球迷，让我们从周二开始。”

items.summaryEn: We drew 1-1 at home to Manchester United in the Women’s Super League on Saturday evening
bodyEn: We drew 1-1 at home to Manchester United in the Women’s Super League on Saturday evening.
Julia Zigiotti’s second-half strike seemed as though it would be the difference between the two sides, but for Smilla Holmberg's 95th-minute equaliser.
PUSHING AND PROBING
We had the first chance of the game as Lisa Baum did well to win the ball off of Jessica Park and create an opening, but her left-footed effort was straight at Phallon Tullis-Joyce.
A Georgia Stanway corner went all the way to the far post and hits Alessia Russo’s head before United cleared the danger, before the visitors had their first sight of goal at the other end.

Misa Rodriguez made two big saves, firstly after Andrea Medina Martin drifted in from the left and found Elisabeth Terland, whose strike towards the bottom right was stopped well by our goalkeeper, before the ball dropped to Terland again and she shot straight at Misa.
In the 24th minute, Olivia Smith beat Anna Sandberg and got a cross in, which was cleared only as far as Stanway and she dragged the ball wide of the bottom left.
We come close to making the breakthrough when Emily Fox’s cross was touched by Russo into the path of Mariona Caldentey, but she curled just wide of the top right.
Then, Stanway’s free-kick from the right was low and met by Leah Williamson, who cushioned it straight into Tullis-Joyce’s gloves.
It was almost 1-0 on the brink of half-time as Baum’s cross from the left was headed towards goal by Stina Blackstenius, but Tullis-Joyce tipped it over the bar and we went into the break level.
NOTHING TO SHOW FOR IT

Ona Batlle found Russo early in the second half and she put the ball across the face of goal, but Maya Le Tissier hooked it out for a corner. Stanway then curled a cross to the far post and Tullis-Joyce retrieved possession.
Park smashed the ball over the bar from the edge of the area, before we made our first two changes in the 58th minute with Holmberg and Kim Little coming on for Smith and Mariona.

Little’s cross was headed wide by Russo in the 63rd minute, but it was United who took the lead moments later as Stanway gave the ball away in a dangerous area and Zigiotti went through on goal, slotting the ball between Misa’s legs for 1-0.
We responded with some attacking changes as Selina Cerci came on for her Arsenal debut alongside Caitlin Foord. They replaced Baum and Blackstenius.
Tullis-Joyce kept United ahead with just under 15 minutes left on the clock, as Holmberg’s cross was met by Foord and her first-time effort was denied.
Chloe Kelly came on for Batlle in the 82nd minute as we continued to find a way back into the game, as Holmberg’s cross was headed straight at Tullis-Joyce by Cerci.
A late Catley corner was headed wide by Williamson, and Kelly tried her luck from distance but the goalkeeper saved again.
LEAVING IT LATE
Five minutes into added time, Williamson's cross to the far post was cushioned into the roof of the net by Holmerg to rescue a point.

items.titleZh: 战报：阿森纳女足 1-1 曼联女足
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳女足在周六晚间的英超女足联赛中主场1-1战平曼联。
bodyZh: 我们在周六晚间的英超女足联赛中主场1-1战平曼联。
朱莉娅·齐吉奥蒂在下半场的进球一度让双方分出胜负，但斯米拉·霍姆伯格在第95分钟完成绝平。
持续施压与试探
我们创造了本场比赛的第一次机会，丽莎·鲍姆从杰西卡·帕克脚下断球并制造空当，但她的左脚射门正入法隆·图利斯-乔伊下怀。
乔治娅·斯坦韦开出角球至远门柱，击中阿莱西亚·鲁索的头部后被曼联解围，随后客队在另一端迎来了首次射门威胁。
米萨·罗德里格斯做出两次精彩扑救，先是在安德烈娅·梅迪纳·马丁从左路内切找到伊丽莎白·特兰德后，对方近角射门被我们的门将神勇化解，随后球再次落到特兰德脚下，她的射门正中米萨下怀。
第24分钟，奥利维娅·史密斯过掉安娜·桑德贝里并送出传中，解围球落到斯坦韦脚下，她的低射偏出左下角。
我们险些打破僵局，埃米利·福克斯的传中经鲁索轻蹭来到马里奥娜·卡尔登特伊脚下，但她的兜射稍稍偏出右上角。
随后，斯坦韦罚出右侧定位球，莉亚·威廉姆森将球卸下后直接送入图利斯-乔伊怀中。
半场结束前我们险些取得1-0领先，鲍姆左路传中，斯蒂娜·布莱克斯蒂纽斯头球攻门，但图利斯-乔伊将球托出横梁，双方半场战平。
努力未能转化为胜势
奥娜·巴特利在下半场初段找到鲁索，后者将球扫向门前，但玛雅·勒蒂谢尔将球解围出底线。随后斯坦韦将角球兜至远门柱，图利斯-乔伊将球没收。
帕克在禁区边缘劲射高出横梁，随后我们在第58分钟做出前两次换人调整，霍姆伯格和金·利特替补登场换下史密斯和马里奥娜。
第63分钟，利特的传中被鲁索头球顶偏，但片刻之后反而是曼联取得领先，斯坦韦在危险地带失误丢球，齐吉奥蒂单刀突入，将球从米萨两腿之间射入，比分变为1-0。
我们随即做出进攻调整，塞尔娜·切尔奇替补登场完成阿森纳首秀，与凯特琳·福德一同出场，他们换下了鲍姆和布莱克斯蒂纽斯。
比赛还剩不到15分钟时，图利斯-乔伊力保曼联领先，霍姆伯格传中找到福德，但后者的抢射被化解。
克洛伊·凯利在第82分钟替补登场换下巴特利，我们继续寻找扳平比分的方法，霍姆伯格的传中被切尔奇直接顶向图利斯-乔伊。
随后卡特利开出角球被威廉姆森头球顶偏，凯利尝试远射但门将再次将球扑住。
压哨绝平
补时第5分钟，威廉姆森传中至远门柱，霍姆伯格将球垫入网窝顶端，为球队抢下一分。

items.titleEn: Konsa – ‘No excuses, we weren’t good enough’
items.summaryEn: Our defender believes we got what we deserved in Brighton defeat
bodyEn: Ezri Konsa was in no mood to look for excuses after suffering the first defeat of his Arsenal career.

The defender had won all five of his Gunners games before heading to the south coast on Saturday, but we could do nothing to stop Brighton running out 3-0 victors on the day the Seagulls celebrated their 125th anniversary.
After the game Konsa said the team need to put the result behind us as soon as possible.

“We weren't good enough,” he said at full-time. “We set ourselves some high standards and it's important that we don't let those standards go, like we did today. These are things we need to learn from very quickly. We go into the break now and it's time for us to reflect as individuals, collectively and when we do come back, we make sure we correct things that we didn't do right today.

“We have to bounce back very quickly. In football, games come thick and fast, but obviously now we're going into the break. But I'm sure everyone as individuals and as a team will go back and focus on what we need to do to improve when we do come back here. We've had a very good couple of months leading up to today. We obviously wanted to keep the momentum going, which we were doing. Like I said, we know ourselves as players that today wasn't good enough. We have to work on what went wrong today.”

This was our biggest league defeat for more than three years, when Brighton beat us 3-0 again at Emirates Stadium in May 2023, and it’s only the second time in the last 158 matches in all competitions that we have conceded more than twice in the same game.
Konsa believes the players need to learn the lessons from this defeat, and get back to our high standards.

“The first two goals in the first half were very avoidable,” he added. “We possibly could have put more pressure on the ball to stop shots. We didn't do it. We conceded goals and when you give players in the Premier League time to shoot from outside of the box, these things can happen. Like you said, it's unusual for us to concede three. I pride myself on keeping clean sheets. We didn't do it today. It's time for us to go away and reflect and come back and do better.”

The result was all the more surprising given the excellent manor in which we had started the campaign, and we were looking to make it four wins out of four on the road in the past 11 days. Though Konsa did not want to use that punishing schedule as an excuse.

“Four games away from home, we managed to win three of them. There are no excuses. We just weren't good enough today. That's it. There's nothing much more I can say. We'll go away as individuals and I'm sure with the staff we’ll go away and look at what we can do better.”
items.author: Josh James
items.titleZh: 孔萨：没有借口，我们表现不够好
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳后卫坦言客场不敌布莱顿的结果完全能够接受。
bodyZh: 埃兹里·孔萨在遭遇其阿森纳生涯的首次失利后，没有任何寻找借口的意思。
这位后卫在周六前往南部海岸之前赢得了代表枪手的全部五场比赛，但面对庆祝建队125周年的布莱顿，我们无力阻止对手以3-0取胜。
赛后，孔萨表示球队需要尽快将这场失利抛诸脑后。
他在终场时表示：“我们表现得不够好。我们为自己设定了很高的标准，重要的是我们不能像今天这样丢掉这些标准。这些是我们必须非常快地从中吸取教训的事情。我们现在将迎来间歇期，这是我们个人和集体反思的时候，当我们回来时，我们要确保纠正今天做得不对的事情。”
“我们必须非常快地反弹。在足球世界里，比赛一场接一场，但显然现在我们要进入间歇期了。不过我相信每个人作为个人和团队都会回顾并关注我们需要做什么，以便在我们回到这里时有所改进。在今天之前，我们经历了非常好的几个月。我们显然想保持势头，而且我们之前也一直在这样做。就像我说的，我们球员自己知道今天表现得不够好。我们必须找出今天出错的地方并加以改进。”
这是我们三年来最大比分的英超失利，上一次还是在2023年5月布莱顿在酋长球场以同样的比分击败我们，这也是我们在各项赛事过去158场比赛中仅有的第二次单场丢球超过两粒。
孔萨认为球员们需要从这场失利中吸取教训，并重新找回高标准。
他补充道：“上半场的前两个丢球本是可以避免的。我们本可以给球施加更多压力来封堵射门。我们没有做到这一点。我们丢了球，当你给英超球员在禁区外射门的时间时，这种事情就会发生。就像你说的，我们丢三个球并不常见。我以保持零封为傲。我们今天没有做到。现在是我们离开、反思、回来并做得更好的时候了。”
考虑到我们开局阶段的出色表现，这个结果更让人意外，而且我们原本希望在过去11天里实现客场四连胜。不过孔萨并不想把紧密的赛程当成借口。
“四个客场比赛，我们赢了三个。没有什么借口。我们今天就是表现不够好。就是这样。我没有更多可说的了。我们会作为个人去反思，我相信教练组也会去看看我们能做哪些改进。”

items.titleEn: Every word from Arteta's post-Brighton presser
items.summaryEn: The manager on the result, performance and learning lessons
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta could not hide his disappointment after we fell to our first defeat of the season on Saturday afternoon.
Brighton ran out 3-0 winners at the Amex Stadium, and afterwards the manager met the media, to discuss the performance, the start to the season, changes and more.
Here’s every word from his post-match press conference.

On the immediate feeling after the game…Extremely disappointed. But first I think we have to congratulate Brighton for the victory. I think they deserve it, I think they were the better team. From our side, there were certain basics you need to accomplish in football, especially in the Premier League that we were very far from. Winning the first duel, the second ball, that put to the game, especially how direct they were in a really difficult place for us. On top of that, especially in our own half, we didn’t respect any of the principles of play to get out of that man-to-man situation. That puts us on the back foot, so it was very difficult to control the game. When we had moments of dominance and control, we did open them up, but we didn’t finish those actions with the quality that is required to compensate for the things we did wrong. So overall, they deserved to win the game, and it’s a big lesson for us.

On how tough every Premier League game is…I think we knew how difficult it was going to be today. The first thing we discussed was the first part - if you don’t get out of that first pass as winners, it becomes very difficult to dominate the game and to win the game. That’s the game - credit to them for overcoming us and having another edge to what we did. At this level it’s extremely important to understand that before anything else.

On why the performance was uncharacteristic of previous matches…Firstly, because Brighton were really good, they had another bite and their timing was better. There are a lot of moments when the ball is 50/50 and it changes hands, and most of the time it was for them. They opened us up in a really difficult way, that’s something to learn. That’s not going to take away what this team has done, and what the boys have done in the last six or seven weeks since coming back from the World Cup, because with 18 players coming back, the way we’ve competed and the number of games we have won has been remarkable. But this is a big lesson on what it takes to win at this level

On whether he felt something was off early in the game…You could see from the first throw-in, it was so clear. We put ourselves in trouble one, two, three times. We need to get out much quicker than that, and that’s one of the biggest lessons we have to take from the game today.
On if he was tempted to make changes at half-time…I was, but I believed it wasn’t the right moment to do that with the things we wanted to do in the second half, and that decision was made.

On if he sees Declan Rice and Bruno Guimaraes as a long-term midfield duo…It’s one of them, and it worked extremely well when we played Sunderland away and managed to win the game, and today it didn’t work so well for a lot of things that happened behind them as well to make sure they could play a completely different game. It’s something that will for sure evolve, they’ve only played together a few minutes in these early stages, and that relationship will for sure improve and give us a lot of joy.

On how this league cannot be easily won…That for us crystal clear. We knew when we talked for two days what we had to do here. We’ve played our fourth away game in a very short space of time, and we know what it takes to win every single match. We know what it has to take to beat Leeds when we come back. That’s for sure not a surprise, but doesn’t take away from the disappointment and emotional state we have right now.

On what was going through his mind when each goal went in…Ways to be able to change it. Okay, we started to get more control and dominance for another action, but that gave them more belief and more momentum again. When you get into those moments, it’s extremely difficult to be able to change it. We tried to change it at half-time, we started the second half and then we made two or three really difficult decisions that put us under more pressure. By the time we got some momentum, it was probably too late.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛后新闻发布会全盘点
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈球队失利、英超竞争及吸取教训。
bodyZh: 周六下午，阿森纳遭遇了本赛季的首场失利，米克尔·阿尔特塔赛后难掩失望之情。
布莱顿在美国运通球场以3-0取胜，赛后主教练出席了新闻发布会，讨论了球队的表现、赛季开局、人员调整等话题。
以下是他赛后新闻发布会的全部内容。

关于赛后的即时感受……极其失望。但首先我认为我们必须祝贺布莱顿取得胜利。我认为他们实至名归，他们是更好的一方。从我们这边来看，足球比赛中有一些基本要素是需要完成的，特别是在英超联赛中，而我们远未达到标准。赢得第一次对抗、争夺第二落点，尤其是考虑到他们在这样一个对我们来说非常艰难的球场踢得如此直接。最重要的是，特别是在我们自己的半场，我们没有遵守任何摆脱人盯人局面的比赛原则。这让我们处于被动防守状态，因此很难掌控比赛。当我们有过占据主导地位和控制权的时刻时，我们确实撕开了对手的防线，但我们没有以所需的质量完成那些进攻，来弥补我们所犯下的错误。总而言之，他们配得上这场胜利，这对我们是一个沉重的教训。
关于英超每场比赛的艰难程度……我想我们很清楚今天会有多艰难。我们讨论的第一件事就是开局——如果你在第一次传球中没有成为胜者，要想主导比赛并赢得比赛就会变得非常困难。比赛就是这样——称赞他们战胜了我们，并在我们所做的事情上增加了另一种优势。在这个水平上，在其他任何事情之前理解这一点是极其重要的。

关于为什么这场比赛的表现与以往不同……首先，因为布莱顿真的很出色，他们更有韧性，时机把握得更好。有很多时候球处于50对50的争抢中并易手，而大多数时候球权都落在了他们脚下。他们以一种非常困难的方式撕开了我们的防线，这是需要学习的东西。这不会抹杀这支球队所做的一切，也不会抹杀小伙子们自世界杯归来后的六七周里所做的一切，因为有18名球员回归的情况下，我们的竞争方式和赢得的比赛数量是极其出色的。但这对于在这个级别取胜所需的条件是一个深刻的教训。
关于是否觉得比赛刚开始时有些不对劲……从第一个界外球就能看出来，非常明显。我们一、二、三次让自己陷入麻烦。我们需要比这更快地摆脱困境，这是我们必须从今天的比赛中吸取的最大教训之一。
关于是否曾想在半场时做出调整……我想过，但我认为结合我们想在下半场做的事情，当时并不是做这件事的正确时机，这个决定已经做出了。
关于是否将德克兰·赖斯和布鲁诺·吉马良斯视为长期的中场搭档……这是其中一种组合，我们在客场对阵桑德兰并设法取胜时，它运作得非常好，而今天由于他们身后的很多情况导致他们无法踢出完全不同的比赛，所以它并没有那么好用。这肯定会发展的，他们在早期阶段只一起踢了几分钟，这种默契肯定会提高，并会给我们带来很多欢乐。
关于这个联赛是如何无法轻易取胜的……这对我们来说非常清楚。我们用了两天时间讨论来到这里必须要做的事情。我们在极短的时间内迎来了第四个客场比赛，我们知道赢得每一场比赛需要付出什么。我们知道当我们回来时战胜利兹联需要付出什么。这绝对不是一个惊喜，但并不能消除我们现在的失望和情绪状态。
关于每个进球丢球时他的脑海在想什么……寻找改变它的方法。好吧，我们通过另一次进攻开始获得更多的控制权和主导地位，但这给了他们更多的信念和更多的势头。当你进入那些时刻时，想要改变它是极其困难的。我们试图在半场进行调整，我们开始了下半场，然后我们做出了两三个非常困难的决定，这给我们带来了更大的压力。当我们重新获得势头时，可能已经太晚了。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta admitted Arsenal were taught a lesson by free-scoring Brighton as their 100% start to the season was abruptly ended on Saturday. Not since 10 May 2023 – 1,224 days ago – when the same opponents won 3-0 at the Emirates Stadium had the Premier League champions lost by three goals. But they were second-best throughout as Pascal Gross, Charalampos Kostoulas and Chema Andrés rounded off a comprehensive victory.

“They deserved to win the game and it’s a big lesson for us,” said a disappointed Arteta, who felt his players were not their usual combative selves. “From the first throw-in you could sense it, it was so clear.
“We put ourselves in trouble one time, two times, three times and we need to get out of that much quicker than that. That’s one of the biggest lessons that we have to take from the game.

“We knew how tough it was going to be and the first thing we had discussed was about the first part. If you don’t get out of that first part as winners, it will be extremely difficult to dominate the game and to have any probability of winning the game. At this level, it’s extremely important to respect and to understand [that] before anything else.”

bodyEn: So much for the new Invincibles. Arsenal were brought back down to earth with a shuddering bump by a scintillating display from Brighton as Fabian Hürzeler’s vibrant side celebrated the club’s 125th anniversary in style.

The special edition shirts they wore to mark the occasion will end up being collector’s items after the Premier League champions were ripped apart. Arsenal were attempting to record an eighth successive victory in all competitions to start the new campaign for the first time since 1903 when they were still known as Woolwich Arsenal.

Instead, it is Brighton – inspired by first-half goals from the veteran stand-in captain, Pascal Gross, and the exciting teenager Charalampos Kostoulas – who find themselves in third place, two points behind Arsenal. New signing Chema Andrés made the points safe from a corner 12 minutes into the second half. That meant Arsenal conceded three goals for the first time since December 2023 in all competitions and Mikel Arteta will be most concerned that it could easily have been more against the division’s top scorers, 16 in five games.

The home supporters waved blue and white flags before kick-off as the players swapped their usual kits for a deep blue limited edition shirt that was inspired by their first season in Southern League Division Two in 1901. That has caused controversy among fans after originally being listed on sale for £150 in a package that included a letter of authenticity from the club owner, Tony Bloom, and a keyring. Given this is the only time they will wear it, those who shelled out will be pleased they did now.

What has made Brighton’s goalscoring exploits so impressive is that they have managed it almost completely without their first-choice attack due to injury, while last year’s top scorer, Danny Welbeck, was sold to Chelsea in the summer. Georginio Rutter returned as a late substitute, but the damage had already been inflicted by then thanks to Gross and Kostoulas.

Jurriën Timber looked leggy on his first start since March and Bruno Guimarães was disappointing on his first Premier League start for Arsenal. Myles Lewis-Skelly’s energy and drive in midfield was sorely missed in the week he was recalled to the England squad.

From the first whistle, Kostoulas – signed last summer for £30m – led Brighton’s fearsome press that provoked Arsenal into a number of uncharacteristic errors, including a misplaced pass from Guimarães that forced David Raya to tip a deflected effort from the 19-year-old around the post. Raya was also guilty of donating possession to the lively Yasin Ayari in a dangerous position. Arsenal and Arteta looked rattled for the first time this season.

Christos Tzolis could not take a rare opportunity on the break after being picked out by Bukayo Saka and they were made to pay for it just after the half-hour mark. Perhaps wary of the unmarked Ayari to their left, Gabriel Magalhães and Riccardo Calafiori were slow to challenge Gross when he received the ball on the edge of Arsenal’s area from Kostoulas and the veteran picked his spot perfectly off the inside of the post.

Ayari came close to doubling the lead five minutes before half-time when he fired into the side-netting before Kostoulas did. Saka had just spurned a great chance to equalise after being set up by Martin Ødegaard and once again Gabriel was guilty of ball watching as the Greek striker thumped the ball past Raya from 25 yards.

Arteta immediately sent out Max Dowman, who scored two goals against Ipswich in midweek, to warm up. He must have been tempted to throw the 16-year-old on at the start of the second half as Kostoulas went close again for Brighton.
It was too late once Andrés nodded in at the far post from a pinpoint Gross corner. “Are you Tottenham in disguise?” sang the delighted Brighton fans.

Arteta introduced Dowman with 10 minutes remaining as he emptied his bench. But having been knocked off the top of the Premier League on goal difference courtesy of this heavy loss, there will be plenty of soul-searching during the three-week international break for the Arsenal manager.

items.titleZh: 布莱顿3-0大胜卫冕冠军阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳客场0-3不敌布莱顿，遭遇本赛季首场失利。
bodyZh: 所谓的新不败之师暂告一段落。在法比安·许策尔充满活力的球队以精彩的表现庆祝俱乐部成立125周年之际，阿森纳被无情地打回原形。
在英超卫冕冠军被彻底击溃之后，他们为纪念这一时刻而身穿的特别版球衣最终将成为收藏品。阿森纳原本试图自1903年（当时他们被称为伍尔维奇阿森纳）以来首次在新赛季各项赛事中取得开局八连胜。
然而，凭借老将代理队长帕斯卡尔·格罗斯和令人兴奋的19岁小将哈拉兰博斯·克斯图拉斯在上半场的进球，布莱顿升至积分榜第三位，落后阿森纳两分。新援切马·安德烈斯在下半场开始12分钟后通过角球锁定胜局。这意味着阿森纳自2023年12月以来首次在各项赛事中单场失球达到三球，而米克尔·阿尔特塔最担心的是，面对联赛中进球最多的球队（5场比赛打进16球），失球本可能更多。
主场球迷在开球前挥舞着蓝白相间的旗帜，球员们则换上了深蓝色限量版球衣，其灵感源自他们1901年在南部联赛乙级联赛的第一个赛季。此前该球衣定价150英镑并包含俱乐部老板托尼·布鲁姆的亲笔信和钥匙扣，这在球迷中引发了争议。鉴于这是他们唯一一次穿这件球衣，那些买单的人现在应该会感到高兴了。
布莱顿的进球表现之所以如此令人印象深刻，是因为他们在主力进攻球员几乎全部因伤缺阵的情况下做到了这一点，而上赛季的最佳射手丹尼·维尔贝克也在夏天被卖给了切尔西。热尔尼奥·吕特作为替补在最后时刻复出，但凭借格罗斯和克斯图拉斯的出色发挥，伤害在那之前就已经造成了。
尤里安·廷贝尔自3月以来的首次先发显得有些疲惫，布鲁诺·吉马良斯代表阿森纳的英超首秀也令人失望。在中场缺少了迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利在本周重回英格兰代表队时的活力与冲击力。
从比赛的第一声哨响开始，去年夏天以3000万英镑引进的克斯图拉斯就带领布莱顿展开了凶猛的前场逼抢，迫使阿森纳犯下了多起不应该的失误，其中包括吉马良斯的一次失误传球，迫使大卫·雷亚扑出了这名19岁小将的折射射门。雷亚还在危险地带将球权送给了活跃的亚辛·阿亚里。阿森纳和阿尔特塔看起来在本赛季首次显得有些慌乱。

克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯未能抓住萨卡传球创造的难得反击机会，他们在半场刚过不久就为此付出了代价。加布里埃尔·马加良斯和里卡多·卡拉菲奥里或许是忌惮左侧无人盯防的阿亚里，在克斯图拉斯将球传到阿森纳禁区边缘时，他们反应迟缓未能及时贴防格罗斯，这位老将冷静推射击中立柱内侧破门。
在上半场结束前五分钟，阿亚里的一脚抽射击中边网，随后克斯图拉斯也险些破门。萨卡刚刚浪费了一次由马丁·厄德高创造的绝佳扳平机会，加布里埃尔再次因注意力不集中，目送这名希腊前锋在25码外将球轰入雷亚把守的大门。
阿尔特塔立即派出了在周中对阵伊普斯维奇时打进两球的马克斯·道曼去热身。当克斯图拉斯再次为布莱顿威胁球门时，他一定很想在下半场开始时就换上这位16岁的小将。
当安德烈斯接格罗斯精准的角球在远门柱头球破门时，一切都为时已晚。“你们是托特纳姆热刺假扮的吗？”高兴的布莱顿球迷高唱道。
阿尔特塔在比赛还剩10分钟时换上道曼，用完了所有换人名额。但由于这场惨败导致净胜球劣势从而跌出英超榜首，阿森纳主帅将利用为期三周的国际比赛日进行深刻的反思。

items.summaryEn: Our under-18s coach reflects on the 5-1 masterclass over Norwich City
bodyEn: Under-18s coach Josh Smith was thrilled with his side’s high-scoring showing against Norwich City, making it three wins on the bounce.

The game finished 5-1, with four goals scored in the first half through Axel Donczew, Charlie Purdy and a brace from Jaden Maghoma, before Emerson Nwaneri capped off the rout in stoppage time, much to Josh's approval.
"Very impressed with the first half, to score so early again.

"We have been speaking recently in terms of: once we do score first, can we go again and get the second and the third? I think that performance has been coming. I was very impressed with the first half.

"The lads and the staff feel a little bit disappointed in terms of the second half. They feel like we could have scored a little bit more. They're young and we're trying to aim for consistency, but overall I'm very pleased."
After a slow start to the campaign, September has brought a significant improvement in results, lifting our young Gunners into fifth place with 10 points from their opening six games.
Josh believes the work carried out in training is starting to show on matchday, with his players continuing to gel and combine.
"We give the lads a base structure", he said. "A lot of the stuff that we're starting to see is just based around simple concepts.
"Whether that's off the right unit, the left, sometimes down the centre. We try and keep it as fluid as possible for them. So, yes, it's been very pleasing seeing that."
The triumph in Norfolk extended our winning streak to three, a run of form that was scarcely seen last season, and Josh explains what he believes is key to maintaining that momentum.
"For us as staff and players, it's about sticking to the process.
"As I said, there's going to be ups and downs. Some weeks we're going to win and some we're going to lose.
"But in terms of how we've been training and how we've been behaving, that's the most important thing for us there. Being consistent and sticking to the process."

items.summaryZh: U18主教练回顾了5比1大胜诺维奇的比赛。
bodyZh: U18主教练乔什·史密斯对球队在对阵诺维奇时的出色进球表现感到兴奋，这也是他们取得的三连胜。
比赛最终以5比1告终，上半场由Axel Donczew、查理·帕迪以及贾登·马霍马梅开二度攻入四球，随后埃默森·恩瓦内里在补时阶段锁定胜局，乔什对这一结果非常满意。
“对上半场的表现非常印象深刻，能够再次这么早取得进球。”
“我们最近一直在讨论：一旦我们率先破门，我们能否再接再厉攻入第二球和第三球？我认为这样的表现一直在积累。我对上半场非常印象深刻。”
“小伙子们和教练组对下半场感到有些许遗憾。他们觉得我们本可以进更多的球。他们还年轻，我们正在努力追求稳定性，但总体而言我非常高兴。”
在赛季开局慢热之后，9月份的战绩迎来了显著提升，年轻枪手们在前六场比赛中拿到10分，升至积分榜第五位。
乔什相信，训练中付出的努力开始在比赛日得到体现，球员们之间的默契和配合也在不断加深。
他说：“我们为小伙子们提供了一个基础阵型。我们现在开始看到的很多内容都只是围绕着简单的概念。”
“无论是通过右路、左路，有时通过中路。我们尽量让他们的战术保持流畅。所以，是的，看到这一点非常令人欣慰。”
这场在诺福克的胜利将我们的连胜纪录扩大到了三场，这样的状态上赛季极其罕见，乔什解释了他认为保持这种势头的关键所在。
“对于我们教练组和球员来说，关键在于坚持既定过程。”
“正如我所说，会有起伏。有些周我们会赢，有些周我们会输。”
“但就我们的训练方式和行为举止而言，这才是对我们最重要的事。保持稳定性并坚持既定过程。”

items.titleEn: Premier League news: Carrick brushes aside questions over future, Arteta salutes ‘extraordinary’ Dowman
items.summaryEn: United head coach believes it will take ‘a lot longer than one or two’ setbacks before he is concerned about his job Continue reading...
bodyEn: Michael Carrick said it would take more than one or two defeats before he came under internal pressure as the Manchester United head coach.

United lost 3-2 to Brighton in the Carabao Cup on Wednesday, having led 2-0 at Old Trafford. That followed Sunday’s 1-0 home loss to 10-man Manchester City. United also went down 2-0 at Hull on the opening day of the season and conceded a late equaliser at Everton at the beginning of the month. The results have caused Carrick to come under scrutiny and he was reminded before Sunday’s visit to Fulham that his predecessors, Erik ten Hag and Ruben Amorim, were sacked after 30 months and 14 months, respectively, in the job.

“It will be a lot longer than one or two games of results,” Carrick said when asked when he might come under pressure from United’s hierarchy. “It’s irrelevant for me. I know the club, I know the role, I know what’s expected here in terms of playing at a certain standard.

“In terms of the future and ownership and how long I’ve got, it’s totally nothing, it’s ridiculous to think that way in the position I’m in; it’s just not on the radar. It’s two or three games we haven’t had certain results. We’ve got to perform and we’ve got a lot of games to plan for.”

Carrick is content to take ownership of his team’s performance. “That’s why I’m here. It’s my responsibility, I’m fine with that,” he said. “It’s not a blame game. We always search for things to look at and find the blame, sometimes it gets too much. Blame me, it’s no problem, but it’s not about blaming people. It’s about finding solutions. It’s a collective thing. I know where we want to go and we want to get there fast. We don’t like losing matches, but it doesn’t affect what we do next.”
The 45-year-old was asked if he needs to show more emotion on the touchline. “I need to show more emotion? In what way?” he replied. “What do you want me to show?”

On Friday JJ Gabriel travelled to Barcelona for discussions regarding potentially joining the club, with United understood to have found out via the media despite the 15-year-old being registered with them.

On Tuesday Gabriel told United he wanted his registration rescinded because he wishes to join another club. Real Madrid have a firm interest and it is understood Gabriel and his advisers travelled for preliminary talks with Barcelona.
Carrick said: “The situation will work itself out, whatever way it’s going to work itself out. Making sure he’s OK is the important thing.” Jamie Jackson
Mikel Arteta has praised Max Dowman’s “extraordinary” transition from schoolboy to Arsenal first-team squad member and backed the teenager to make more of an impact this season.

Dowman became the first 16-year-old since Wayne Rooney in October 2002 to score twice for a Premier League club in Arsenal’s victory over Ipswich in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday, after bursting on to the scene last year. That was his first appearance of the campaign, having been an unused substitute on four occasions as Arsenal have won all seven of their fixtures. Dowman, who has been training with Arsenal’s first team since he was 14, completed his GCSEs in the summer and he will study for a BTec qualification after deciding against taking A-Levels. Arteta said Dowman’s development was still being carefully managed by Arsenal after a couple of years of having to balance his studies.

“It’s not easy,” said the Arsenal manager. “That’s what tells you about the craziness of the age and the environment he still lives in with the demands and the competition he needs to face during the week. But the way he has handled it, him and the family, it has been extraordinary. If he is here, he has to be here in all conditions and we cannot treat him differently in many aspects.”

Dowman is in contention to be on the bench to face Brighton on Saturday as Arsenal attempt to make it eight successive victories to start the season for the first time since their promotion season as Woolwich Arsenal in 1903-04. Arteta is convinced more opportunities will come his way sooner rather than later. “That’s the best way to knock on the door: to do it on the pitch, not in the office,” he said. “What Max did the other day, alongside all the players as well, that haven’t played that many minutes, it was really impressive.”

Premier League regulations do not allow players under 17 to be sent out on loan but Luton are understood to have registered an interest in Dowman, who was coached by their manager, Jack Wilshere, when he played for Arsenal’s under-18s. Arteta said it was possible Dowman could be allowed to leave in January, by which point he will be 17, but that his immediate future was at Arsenal.

“We haven’t really listened to any of the possibilities because we were crystal clear that we wanted to have him in the squad, that we wanted him to be part of the pre-season and then start to see where we are from there,” Arteta said.

“We will evaluate every six months, where we are and what is the best thing for him to do and then make the right decision. It depends on a lot of factors – what he needs and what the team needs as well, the availability we have in the squad, the minutes that he is playing and the qualities of those minutes. We have to be open but now the focus is to be here and to impact the team.” Ed Aarons

Roberto De Zerbi has insisted Sandro Tonali was not feeling the pressure of his price tag despite a mixed start to life at Tottenham. The midfielder became the most expensive player in the club’s history when he joined from Newcastle for £92.5m in the summer.

De Zerbi made a big play to sign Tonali amid interest from Manchester City and Arsenal, delivering a two-hour sales pitch to his fellow Italian to convince him to move to north London. He outlined how central Tonali would be to his plans and explained what he could expect from Spurs’ fans and the team’s style of football.

Tonali has started all four Premier League games this season – in which Spurs have drawn twice and lost twice without scoring – but has produced underwhelming defensive numbers and created only three chances.

De Zerbi revealed he had spoken to the 26-year-old about the weight of the price tag and claimed the player “doesn’t feel the pressure about that”. The Spurs manager pointed out that Tonali took time to adapt in his first season at Milan in 2020 before becoming one of the most sought-after young midfielders in the world once he settled there.

De Zerbi said “the adaptation has been not so fast” at Tottenham “but it can happen”, adding: “It is not so easy to change city, to change everything, for the players. Sometimes the adaptation is immediate, sometimes you need more time.”

Tottenham’s struggles in front of goal have not been helped by Tonali’s inability to create chances for the forwards. The goalless draw against Everton was the first in 140 games at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and followed a 0-0 at Nottingham Forest, thereby equalling Spurs’ tally of goalless games in the previous 181 matches. The last time they recorded three or more consecutive goalless draws in the league was 25 years ago under George Graham, when they went to four.

It is a remarkable run, especially after a summer spend of more than £300m, which leaves Spurs in 17th going into Saturday’s game against Aston Villa, who have also struggled after a summer of major change.

De Zerbi maintained he was happy with Tonali’s performances – even though he believed they could improve – and described him as “a complete midfielder”. “His physical characteristics are to play box-to-box but he started his career as a playmaker. He’s good enough with the ball, he’s good enough without the ball.” Sam Cunningham

Daniel Farke said Dominic Calvert-Lewin was “like a good wine” after the in-form striker’s call-up into Thomas Tuchel’s England squad. The 29-year-old has been included in the Three Lions’ squad for their Nations League matches after scoring four goals in six appearances in all competitions this season.

Calvert-Lewin was given a standing ovation by Leeds fans as he was withdrawn late on in Monday night’s 4-1 win against Newcastle at Elland Road. “Dominic is like a good wine, getting better by the year,” Farke said. “Physically, he’s on a top level and his pace is more than good enough I would say. He’s a very complete striker.”

He arrived at Leeds on a free transfer from Everton in August last year and when asked where he ranked among his best signings, Farke said: “At Leeds, while I’ve been here, we’ve made many top signings on a low budget.

“When I think about Joe Rodon, Ethan Ampadu, Ao Tanaka … It’s difficult to compare because as a striker you have a different role. But he’s definitely one of our better pieces of business. If you come as a free agent it doesn’t mean it costs no money because there’s a salary. But we believed in him when perhaps not many were doing this. He also believes in himself and he believes in Leeds United, so I would say he was a perfect fit.” Press Association

items.titleZh: 英超新闻：卡里克淡化对未来的疑问，阿尔特塔赞赏道曼“非凡”的发挥
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔对小将道曼从学生到一线队的非凡过渡表示赞赏，并支持其本赛季产生更大影响。
bodyZh: 迈克尔·卡里克表示，作为曼联主帅，他需要经历多场失利才会受到内部压力。
在老特拉福德以2比0领先的情况下，曼联周三在联赛杯中以2比3输给布莱顿。此前，他们在周日主场0比1不敌少打一人的曼城。曼联还在赛季开局客场0比2不敌赫尔城，并在本月初对阵埃弗顿的比赛中被对手在尾声阶段绝平。这些结果让卡里克受到了严格审视，在周日客场对阵富勒姆之前，人们提醒他，他的前任埃里克·滕哈赫和鲁本·阿莫林分别在任职30个月和14个月后被解雇。
当被问及何时可能面临来自曼联高层的压力时，卡里克表示：“这需要比一两场比赛的结果长得多。这对我来说并不重要。我了解这家俱乐部，了解这个角色，也知道这里对达到一定水准的要求。”
“至于未来、所有权以及我还有多长时间，这完全不存在，在我目前的位置上有这种想法是荒谬的；这根本不在考虑范围内。这是两三场比赛我们没有取得某些结果。我们必须拿出表现，我们有很多比赛要规划。”
卡里克愿意为球队的表现承担责任。“这就是我在这里的原因。这是我的责任，我对此没有异议，”他说。“这不是一场互相指责的游戏。我们总是在寻找事情来审视并寻找责任所在，有时这太过分了。责怪我吧，没问题，但这与责怪别人无关。这是关于寻找解决方案。这是一个集体的事。我知道我们想去哪里，我们想快点到那里。我们不喜欢输球，但这不会影响我们接下来要做什么。”
这位45岁的教练被问及他是否需要在场边表现出更多情绪。“我需要表现出更多情绪？以什么方式？”他回答说，“你想让我表现出什么？”
周五，JJ·加布里埃尔前往巴塞罗那，就潜在加盟该俱乐部进行商谈，据了解曼联是通过媒体才得知这一消息的，尽管这名15岁的球员已在他们那里注册。
周二，加布里埃尔告诉曼联，他希望注销注册，因为他希望加盟另一家俱乐部。皇家马德里表现出浓厚兴趣，据了解加布里埃尔及其顾问已前往巴塞罗那进行初步会谈。
卡里克说：“这种情况会自行解决，无论它将以何种方式解决。确保他一切正常是最重要的事情。” 杰米·杰克逊
米克尔·阿尔特塔称赞了马克斯·道曼从学生到阿森纳一线队成员的“非凡”过渡，并支持这名青少年本赛季产生更大影响。

在周二阿森纳在联赛杯击败伊普斯维奇的比赛中，道曼自去年崭露头角以来梅开二度，成为自2002年10月韦恩·鲁尼以来首位为英超俱乐部单场打进两球的16岁球员。这是他本赛季的首次出场，在此前阿森纳取得七连胜的比赛中，他曾四次未出场替补。道曼自14岁起就一直在阿森纳一线队随队训练，他在夏天完成了GCSE考试，在决定不参加A-Level考试后，他将攻读BTEC资格证书。阿尔特塔表示，在平衡了几年学业后，阿森纳仍在精心管理道曼的发展。
“这并不容易，”阿森纳主教练说。“这就是告诉你他所处的年龄有多疯狂，以及他在一周内需要面对的需求和竞争的生活环境。但他处理这一切的方式，包括他本人和他的家人，都是非凡的。如果他来到这里，他必须在所有条件下都在这里，我们不能在许多方面区别对待他。”
道曼有望进入周六对阵布莱顿的替补席，阿森纳正试图自1903-04赛季以伍尔维奇阿森纳身份升级以来，首次在赛季开局取得八连胜。阿尔特塔坚信，更多机会会早晚到来。“敲门的最好方式是在球场上做到，而不是在办公室里，”他说。“马克斯前几天和其他没有踢那么多时间的球员一起做的事情，真的让人印象深刻。”
英超联赛规定不允许17岁以下的球员外租，但据了解卢顿对道曼表现出了兴趣，道曼在效力阿森纳U18时曾接受过他们现任主教练杰克·威尔希尔的指导。阿尔特塔表示，道曼可能会在一月份被允许离开，届时他将年满17岁，但他目前的未来仍在阿森纳。
阿尔特塔说：“我们没有真正听取任何可能性，因为我们非常清楚，我们希望将他留在阵容中，我们希望他成为季前赛的一部分，然后从那里开始看看我们的处境。”
“我们将每六个月评估一次，我们身处何地，对他来说最好的事情是什么，然后做出正确的决定。这取决于很多因素——他需要什么，球队也需要什么，我们在阵容中拥有的人员可用性，他正在踢的分钟数以及这些分钟的质量。我们必须保持开放，但现在的重点是留在这里并对球队产生影响。” 爱德华·阿隆斯
罗伯托·德泽尔比坚称，尽管在托特纳姆热刺的开局表现喜忧参半，但桑德罗·托纳利并没有感受到身价带来的压力。这位中场球员在夏天以9250万英镑从纽卡斯尔加盟时，成为了俱乐部历史上身价最高的球员。
在曼城和阿森纳的兴趣中，德泽尔比为签下托纳利做出了巨大努力，向这位同胞发表了两个小时的推销演讲，说服他搬到北伦敦。他概述了托纳利在他的计划中将处于多么核心的地位，并解释了他可以从热刺球迷和球队足球风格中期待什么。
托纳利本赛季首发出战了全部四场英超联赛——热刺取得了两平两负且一球未进的战绩——但他的防守数据表现平平，仅创造了三次机会。
德泽尔比透露，他曾与这位26岁的球员谈过身价的重量，并声称这名球员“对此没有感到压力”。热刺主帅指出，托纳利在2020年加盟米兰的第一个赛季也花了一段时间适应，一旦在那里安顿下来，他就成为了世界上最受追捧的年轻中场之一。
德泽尔比表示，托纳利在热刺“适应得不是很快”，“但这是会发生的”，并补充道：“对于球员来说，换城市、改变一切并不是那么容易。有时适应是即时的，有时你需要更多时间。”
由于托纳利无法为前锋创造机会，热刺在门前的挣扎并未得到缓解。主场对阵埃弗顿的互交白卷是托特纳姆热刺球场140场比赛中的第一场，此前他们还在客场0比0战平诺丁汉森林，这追平了热刺在过去181场比赛中的零进球场次纪录。他们上一次在联赛中连续三场或更多场比赛互交白卷还要追溯到25岁前的乔治·格雷厄姆执教时期，当时他们连续四场没有进球。
这是一段引人注目的连胜，尤其是在夏天花费超过3亿英镑之后，这使得热刺在周六对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛前排在第17位，维拉在经历了夏季的大变动后同样表现挣扎。
德泽尔比坚称他对托纳利表现感到满意——尽管他相信他们可以做得更好——并将其描述为“一名全能中场”。“他的身体特点是踢B2B（全能中场），但他以组织核心开始职业生涯。他在有球时足够好，在无球时也足够好。”萨姆·坎宁安
丹尼尔·法尔克在状态正佳的前锋多米尼克·卡尔沃特-勒温入选托马斯·图赫尔的英格兰代表队后，称赞他“就像一瓶好酒”。这位29岁的球员在本赛季各项赛事出场6次打进4球后，入选了三狮军团的欧国联大名单。
在周一晚埃兰路球场4比1战胜纽卡斯尔的比赛尾声被换下时，卡尔沃特-勒温受到了利兹联球迷起立鼓掌的礼遇。“多米尼克就像一瓶好酒，随着年岁增长而变得更好，”法尔克说。“在身体上，他处于顶级水平，我要说他的速度也足够好。他是一个非常全面的前锋。”
他在去年8月以自由转会的方式从埃弗顿加盟利兹联，当被问及他在自己最好的引援中排在什么位置时，法尔克说：“在利兹联，自我来到这里以来，我们在低预算下完成了许多顶级引援。”
“当我想到乔·罗登、伊桑·阿帕杜、田中碧……这很难比较，因为作为前锋，你扮演着不同的角色。但他绝对是我们最好的几笔交易之一。如果你以自由球员身份加盟，并不意味着不花钱，因为还有薪水。但当或许没有多少人这样做时，我们信任了他。他也相信自己，相信利兹联，所以我想说他是完美契合。”新闻协会

bodyEn: The poet Jorge Luis Borges wrote a famous short story about a society that had become so good at making maps, so obsessed with capturing every detail, that its rulers decided the only way to do the job right was to make a lifesize map of its entire empire, which could then be laid out across the actual land from coast to coast. Imagine a map of Britain the exact same size as Britain, showing every branch of Greggs, every nail bar, every vape shop in perfect detail. Only then can we really see what Britain looks like, by standing on a fake Britain laid over the top of actual Britain.

Borges was writing in the 1940s, at a time when people were fascinated by the mechanised future, with its new forms of measuring out the world: the wireless, the 30mph motorcar, the rise of Big Tape Measure. And to be fair, the mega-map is a pretty accurate vision of our own fully networked present, a place where you can snoop around a village in Mozambique from your laptop in Egham, where no one ever stops committing acts of minute self-surveillance, even if they think they’re just searching “What is beetroot?” on the internet.

Borges also hated football. “Soccer is popular because stupidity is popular,” he wrote, which probably seemed a bold statement at the time. But then Borges also didn’t live to see an episode of Wow Sports Premier League Breakfast at Breakfast with Roger McRoger and a puzzled Lee Trundle. After which, perhaps less of a surprise. But the process he describes is also a good description of what football is doing to itself. Endless data, endless analysis, no spaces or free air, matches that are just schematised movement. At times it can feel like football is out there laying a lifesize real-time map on top of itself.

In Borges’s story, the land soon begins to decay beneath the massive map – which is reassessed by later generations as insane, pointless and stupid – and left to rot in the desert. We haven’t reached this point. Nobody is de-mapping football. But it does perhaps explain why everyone gets so excited when a talent emerges that seems to be playful and human, to exist outside the grid. And also why it has felt wrong to gush too soon about Max Dowman, to fear placing the hex on him. We know how this works. Here is a fluffy new thing. Let us break him. Let us heap pressure on his shoulders. Don’t talk about Max Dowman. Let Max Dowman exist, breathe, bloom in the shadows.

So, Max Dowman then. It has become quite hard to ignore him. He was brilliant against Ipswich in midweek, and brilliant in a way that seems solid and real and comfortable with itself. Most obviously there were the two goals, both a perfect snapshot of why Dowman seems equipped to survive, more state‑of‑the‑art than some other young players we’ve burdened with expectation.

The second goal is particularly good, five perfect little actions packed into six seconds of football. Arsenal have the ball on the edge of the Ipswich box. Dowman shows for a pass, sees it’s going elsewhere, changes his mind, and makes a three-yard sprint to create space. Finally he has the physical capacity to control a bouncing ball in that sliver of space, to move his feet so much quicker than the nearest defender it looks like a glitch in the machine, and to finish in a way that involves sifting the options and timing the shot, all without breaking stride.

The first goal is on his other side, and involves a more classical piece of one-on-one deception. This is the same defender: Cédric Kipré, 29 years old, came through Paris Saint-Germain’s youth system. Dowman walks through him with a micro-feint and a switch of feet, then reels off another hilariously understated finish, doing it all while a second defender is still gathering himself to lunge, like a man operating in a different time signature to everyone around him.

This is the key point of difference, the ability to make everything stop, the fly-vision that means he sees what’s about to happen while everyone else is whirling about trying to read the charts, in the same way Lionel Messi (yes, sorry, sorry) always seems to have time to pass the ball into the net, like this is all a kickabout in a pair of sliders.

Our way of understanding young creative players has often seemed to lag behind where the game actually is, to be driven by nostalgia for what this thing used to look like. I remember the excitement over the 18-year-old Jack Rodwell’s physicality at the exact moment physicality was no longer going to be a thing, like proudly unveiling the latest horse‑drawn train just as the Ford Model T rolls off the production line.

Michael Owen was brilliant at 17, but he was mainly brilliant at running very fast in a straight line and smashing the ball into the net. Plus of course there was Wayne Rooney, who emerged a pale, unformed teenager composed entirely from energy drinks and white bread, out there making the game up on the fly, as though some urban foundling had come barrelling over the advert boards with a string of sausages still dangling from his mouth.

The narrative around Rooney is that he lost this vital native quality. But Rooney adapted and survived, and clearly understood what he had to be a lot better than those of us watching. And even now creative players have to exist against this. Cole Palmer is exciting because he does surprising things that seem to be striking a blow for freedom, beauty and older people who struggle to make their email work. But his real challenge is to retain just enough of this while fitting the world around him.

Dowman is a bit different. The things that make him stand out seem to speak very easily to how football is now. Being a modern creative footballer is not jinking runs, rasping drives or dribbling across a cabbage field in a pair of cowboy boots. It’s targeted energy, high-intensity semi-freedom. Lamine Yamal and Désiré Doué have the same fast-twitch foot and brain speed, the ability to operate in micro-moments, to see patterns just ahead of time. Dowman is 6ft tall and getting stronger. He won’t be kicked to pieces. He can repeat this without taking bites out of himself.

There is still the issue of his youth. But maybe this doesn’t matter so much either. The world has changed. In the age of Rooney and Owen there was no care, no data, no softness. This is where the structures of modern football are an advantage. Dowman will be GPS’d to the last decimal point. Endless physical scientists will have a say on his output and stress levels.

The money is too big. The talent is too valuable. It also comes ready to plug and play. You don’t get to this level unless you can ingest systems and briefings. You’ve already been pressure-cooked and stress-tested. What you’re being asked to do in the orderly spaces of professional football is the same thing you were asked to do in the orderly spaces of academy football, just five levels up and with more people watching.

Borges was anti-football because he saw it as inauthentic, the players no longer sports people but “actors in jerseys before the TV cameras”. And this is also fine, further evidence that boomer-dad nostalgia is one of the key archetypes of human behaviour.

Life is also different now; not harder or easier, but more instant, a series of moments, the creation of rapid-fire energy. Dowman has grown up inside this. He can parcel his time out, disappear for a bit, maybe make a show of things in the spring.

And yes, this is another way of fitting him to a model, laying a lifesize map of future Max Dowman across the present. But I strongly suspect he will be fine, and that unlike so many other things out there he’s pretty well adapted to whatever the future is supposed to look like.
items.author: Barney Ronay
items.titleZh: 我们本想让马克斯·道曼在阴影中绽放，但他如今已让人难以忽视
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳小将马克斯·道曼表现出色，展现出适应现代足球的巨大潜力。
bodyZh: 诗人豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯曾写过一篇著名的短篇小说，讲述了一个极其擅长绘制地图、痴迷于捕捉每一个细节的社会，其统治者认为把工作做好的唯一方法就是绘制一张与整个帝国等大的地图，然后将其铺在从海岸到海岸的实际土地上。想象一下一张与英国大小完全相同的英国地图，以完美的细节显示了格雷格斯的每一家分店、每一家美甲店、每一家电子烟店。只有这样，通过站在覆盖在真实英国之上的虚假英国上，我们才能真正看到英国是什么样子的。
博尔赫斯写作于20世纪40年代，当时人们对机械化的未来及其衡量世界的新方式着迷：无线电设备、时速30英里的汽车、巨型卷尺的兴起。平心而论，超级地图确实是我们现在这个完全联网的时代的精准愿景，在这里你可以通过英厄姆的笔记本电脑窥探莫桑比克的一个村庄，在这里没有人会停止进行微观的自我监视，即使他们认为自己只是在互联网上搜索“什么是甜菜根”。

博尔赫斯也讨厌足球。“足球受欢迎是因为愚蠢受欢迎，”他写道，这在当时可能是一个很大胆的说法。但博尔赫斯也没有活到看到罗杰·麦克罗杰和困惑的李·特伦德主持的《疯狂体育英超早餐》节目的那一刻。在那之后，也许就不会那么令人惊讶了。但他所描述的过程也是足球对其自身所做事情的生动写照。无休止的数据、无休止的分析、没有空间或自由空气、比赛只是图解式的运动。有时人们会觉得足球正在把一张与现实等时的地图铺在自己身上。

在博尔赫斯的故事中，巨大的地图之下的土地很快就开始腐烂——后来几代人重新评估其为疯狂、毫无意义和愚蠢——并任其在沙漠中腐烂。我们还没有到达这一点。没有人会取消足球的地图化。但这也许可以解释为什么当一个看起来俏皮、有人情味且存在于网格之外的天才涌现时，每个人都会如此兴奋。这也解释了为什么过早对马克斯·道曼大加赞赏会让人感觉不对劲，并担心给他带来魔咒。我们知道这是怎么回事。这是一个毛茸茸的新东西。让我们摧毁他。让我们把压力压在他的肩膀上。不要谈论马克斯·道曼。让马克斯·道曼存在、呼吸并在阴影中绽放。
那么，说说马克斯·道曼吧。现在要忽视他变得相当困难。他在周中的比赛中对阵伊普斯威奇时表现出色，这种出色显得扎实、真实且内心笃定。最明显的是那两个进球，这两个进球都是完美的快照，解释了为什么道曼似乎具备生存的能力，比我们赋予期望的其他一些年轻球员更具现代感。
第二个进球格外精彩，在六秒钟的足球比赛中包含了五个完美的微小动作。阿森纳在伊普斯威奇禁区边缘控球。道曼寻求传球，发现球传向别处，改变了主意，并进行了三码的冲刺来创造空间。最终，他在那个狭小的空间里具备了控制弹地球的身体能力，其挪动双脚的速度比最近的防守球员快得多，看起来就像机器出了故障，并且能够通过筛选选项和掌握射门时机的方式完成破门，而且全程步伐没有丝毫停顿。
第一个进球在她的另一侧，涉及更经典的一对一欺骗。这是同一名防守球员：塞德里克·基普雷，29岁，出自巴黎圣日耳曼青训营。道曼通过一次微假动作和脚法切换轻松过掉了他，随后又完成了一次令人捧腹的低调射门，这一切发生时，第二名防守球员还在调整身体准备扑抢，就像一个在与周围所有人处于不同时空节奏中运作的人。
这是关键的区别所在，这种让一切都停下来的能力，这种飞行般的视野意味着当其他所有人都在疯狂旋转试图解读图表时，他能看到即将发生的事情，就像莱昂内尔·梅西（是的，对不起，对不起）总是似乎有时间把球传进球门一样，就好像这一切只是穿着拖鞋在踢野球一样。
我们理解年轻创造型球员的方式似乎总是滞后于比赛的实际现状，并受到对过去事物怀旧情绪的驱使。我记得当18岁的杰克·罗德威尔的身体素质在身体素质不再重要的那一刻引发轰动时，就像在福特T型车刚下生产线时自豪地展示最新的马车火车一样。
迈克尔·欧文在17岁时就非常出色，但他主要的出色之处在于直线跑得非常快并将球轰入球网。当然还有韦恩·鲁尼，他作为一个面色苍白、尚未成型的青少年出现，完全由能量饮料和白面包组成，在场上即兴发挥，就像某种城市弃儿嘴里还叼着一串香肠越过广告牌狂奔而来一样。
围绕鲁尼的叙事是他失去了这种至关重要的本土特质。但鲁尼适应并生存了下来，并且显然比我们这些旁观者更清楚他必须成为什么样的人。即使在现在，创造型球员也必须在这种环境下生存。科尔·帕尔默令人兴奋，因为他做出了令人惊讶的事情，似乎在为自由、美以及那些电子邮件运行困难的老年人进行抗争。但他真正的挑战是在适应周围世界的同时，保留足够多的这种特质。
道曼则有些不同。让他脱颖而出的特质似乎非常契合现代足球的发展方向。现代创造型足球运动员不是花哨的盘带、刺耳的抽射，也不是穿着牛仔靴在菜地里盘带。而是有针对性的能量、高强度的半自由。亚马尔和杜埃拥有相同的快速应变脚法和头脑速度，具备在微观时刻运作的能力，能够在稍早前看到比赛的规律。道曼身高六英尺，而且身体变得更强壮了。他不会被踢得支离破碎。他可以重复这一点而不会消耗自己。
年轻仍然是个问题。但也许这也不是那么重要。世界已经变了。在鲁尼和欧文的时代，没有关怀，没有数据，没有温情。这就是现代足球结构发挥优势的地方。道曼将被精确到小数点后最后一位的GPS定位。无休止的体能科学家将对他的输出和压力水平发表意见。
资金太庞大了。天赋太宝贵了。它也做好了即插即用的准备。你若不具备吸收战术体系和简报的能力，就无法达到这个水平。你已经被高压烹调和压力测试过了。在职业足球有序的空间里被要求做的事情，和你在学院足球有序的空间里被要求做的事情是一样的，只是级别更高，有更多的人在观看。
博尔赫斯反足球是因为他认为足球是不真实的，球员不再是运动员，而是“电视摄像机前的球衣演员”。这也是可以理解的，这进一步证明了嬉皮士老爸式的怀旧是人类行为的关键原型之一。
生活现在也不同了；不是更难或更容易，而是更加瞬息万变，是一系列瞬间，是快速爆发能量的创造。道曼就是在这种环境下长大的。他可以分配自己的时间，消失一会儿，也许在春天大显身手。
是的，这也是将他纳入某种模版、将未来马克斯·道曼的等大地图铺在现实之上的另一种方式。但我坚信他会没事的，与外界许多其他事物不同，他非常适应未来的模样。

bodyEn: Chelsea have not won this west London derby since Brentford’s first Premier League season. Each visit since October 2021’s 1-0 win, Ben Chilwell the scorer, has been a draw. This season has continued the divergence between the clubs’ respective approaches, Brentford’s solidity and continuity contrasting with Chelsea attempting their latest reboot. Kevin Schade, after two well-taken goals at Bournemouth, will fancy facing a defence not yet attuned to Xabi Alonso’s configurations. Only one team has won a Premier League title with a defensive trio: Chelsea’s last title team, in 2016-17 under Antonio Conte. Alonso’s attack has been rather more successful, presenting another challenge for Jannik Schuster. Replacing Nathan Collins, the 20-year-old central defender had a tough examination from Bournemouth’s Evanilson on his first Premier League start, emerging with credit. For Chelsea, João Pedro has three goals and three assists, but doubts surrounding his fitness could lead to Danny Welbeck’s first league start. John Brewin
Brentford v Chelsea, Friday 8pm (all times BST)

What happens when a very stoppable force meets an extremely movable object? We will be tuning into events at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on Saturday to find out as 19th-placed Aston Villa arrive in north London. The teams have scored one goal between them in the league and are desperately hoping for a first Premier League win. The return of Pedro Porro is big for Roberto De Zerbi and that should bring the Archie Gray Experiment at right-back to a merciful end. No Premier League starting XI feels less settled than Spurs – most players look as if they are a mistake or two from being dropped – which has culminated in a side that seems governed by fear and continuously prefers to take the safe option. After coming off the bench against Everton and Liverpool in the past week, the injury-plagued James Maddison will be itching to start and take some sort of initiative for Tottenham. Michael Butler
Tottenham v Aston Villa, Saturday 12.30pm

When Fabian Hürzeler spoke about Brighton’s success being founded on them being “well structured” after their stirring comeback against Manchester United at Old Trafford on Wednesday, he could have been referring to Malick Yalcouyé. The 20-year-old Ivorian moved to the south coast in 2024 after spending just a few months with IFK Gothenburg in Sweden but had to wait until this season to make his senior debut for Brighton after being sent on loan to Sturm Graz in Austria and then Swansea last season. With Jack Hinshelwood sidelined by injury until after the international break, Yalcouyé has taken his chance in the No 10 role and already found the net twice in the Premier League as Brighton have made a brilliant start. Arsenal are up next for the division’s top scorers – who have 13 goals from their opening four matches – and Mikel Arteta should be wary of the threat posed by Yalcouyé and co as the champions prepare for a fourth away game in succession. Ed Aarons
Brighton v Arsenal, Saturday 3pm

Vitalii Mykolenko’s early-season improvement has gone largely unheralded – and it probably always will be among his detractors – but at a time when David Moyes needs experienced players to step up and defy the constraints of a small squad, the Everton left-back has produced. Having signed a new three-year contract in the summer, and seemingly bulked up, the Ukraine international has kept his critics quiet with several impressive displays for a defence that has four clean sheets in six matches. There remains a problematic lack of cover at left-back after the decision to loan Adam Aznou to Málaga for the season but Mykolenko, the better defender, has eased the concerns that surrounded his position before the new campaign. Everton v Ipswich, Saturday 3pm

Bobb had a good World Cup and should be full of confidence when Fulham, still seeking their first win in the league this season, host Manchester United. Jacob Steinberg
Fulham v Manchester United, Sunday 4.30pm

bodyEn: Mikel Merino says Max Dowman reminds him of Lamine Yamal after the Arsenal prodigy continued his development by scoring twice in his side’s 4-2 win against Ipswich.

Dowman, who has been given a host of opportunities at senior level by Mikel Arteta, starred after being handed his first appearance of the season, at Portman Road on Tuesday. The 16-year-old attacker’s classy double eased Arsenal into the last 16 of the Carabao Cup and left Arteta admitting that containing the hype around the England youth international is not an easy task.

Arsenal are managing Dowman carefully and Merino is well placed to see how young talents can benefit from listening to managers and older players. The Arsenal midfielder plays with Lamine Yamal for Spain and believes Dowman is as fearless as the 19-year-old winger.

“There are some similarities in terms of their character,” he said. “They don’t care about the spotlight. They thrive when pressure is at the highest. They are always up for the challenge and they are not shy at all – even facing the biggest names in the game.”

Merino, who also scored against Ipswich, raved about Dowman. “He is an unbelievable talent. We knew it, but every time he goes on the pitch and plays against grown men he makes the difference. He is a big talent and we have to take care of him.

“We have to keep pushing him. He needs to keep learning – eyes and ears open always. There is still big room for improvement in a lot of areas and he knows that. So we are going to be by his side trying to get him to his best level.

“It is a thin line. It is very difficult to have equilibrium sometimes with him, because obviously you want him to shine and show everyone the talent that he has. But you have to sometimes remind them that they are human beings and they are part of a bigger squad and team.

“The good thing with these kind of players – Lamine and Max – is that they are special talents, but at the same time they are very humble. They are always keen to learn and listen to the veterans. That is priceless.”

Merino also praised Marli Salmon after the 17-year-old impressed against Ipswich. “In that position as a centre-back, you need to be very mature,” he said.

“It’s very important you don’t make many mistakes. Every action is crucial. It’s the same as with Max, he is an unbelievable talent. We try to teach them our experience and they are very good at listening.”

items.titleZh: 梅里诺：阿森纳新星道曼让我想起了亚马尔
items.summaryZh: 道曼在对阵伊普斯威奇的比赛中独中两元，梅里诺称赞他是位极具天赋的球员。
bodyZh: 在阿森纳以4-2战胜伊普斯威奇的比赛中，天才小将道曼梅开二度，继续着他的成长轨迹，米克尔·梅里诺表示这让他想起了亚马尔。
道曼在周二的波特曼路球场迎来了本赛季的首次登场并大放异彩，米克尔·阿尔特塔此前已在成年队比赛中给了他许多出场机会。这位16岁攻击手的精彩双响帮助阿森纳轻松晋级联赛杯16强，这也让阿尔特塔承认，控制外界对这位英格兰青年国脚的炒作并非易事。
阿森纳正在谨慎地培养道曼，而梅里诺很清楚年轻才俊如何能从听取教练和老队员的意见中受益。这位阿森纳中场与亚马尔在西班牙国家队并肩作战，他认为道曼和这位19岁的边锋一样无所畏惧。
“他们在性格上有相似之处，”他说。“他们不在乎聚光灯。当压力达到顶峰时，他们反而能茁壮成长。他们总是勇于迎接挑战，而且一点也不害羞——即使面对比赛中最大牌的球星也是如此。”
同样在对阵伊普斯威奇的比赛中取得进球的梅里诺对道曼赞不绝口。“他是一个不可思议的天才。我们早就知道这一点，但每次他上场与成年人对抗时，他都能改变比赛。他是一个巨大的天才，我们必须照顾好他。”
“我们必须继续推动他。他需要不断学习——时刻保持眼观六路、耳听八方。在许多方面仍有很大的改进空间，他也很清楚这一点。所以我们会站在他身边，努力让他达到最佳水平。”
“这是一条微妙的界限。有时很难在他身上保持平衡，因为你显然希望他发光并向所有人展示他的天赋。但你有时必须提醒他们，他们是人类，他们是一个更大的阵容和团队的一部分。”
“这类球员的好处——无论是亚马尔还是马克思（道曼），他们都是特殊的天才，但与此同时他们也非常谦逊。他们总是热衷于学习并倾听老将们的教诲。这是无价的。”

梅里诺还称赞了马尔利·萨尔蒙，这位17岁小将在对阵伊普斯威奇的比赛中表现亮眼。“在那个中后卫的位置上，你需要非常成熟，”他说。
“不犯太多错误非常重要。每一个动作都至关重要。就像马克思一样，他是一个不可思议的天才。我们试图将我们的经验传授给他们，他们非常善于倾听。”

items.summaryEn: Max Dowman struck twice as the Gunners eased past the hosts to advance to the fourth roundAllan Castle writes in:As a British-born Canadian, who has shuttled back and forth over the Atlantic for six decades, when I get back to England I seek out cherished beverages past and present that are unavailable or only sporadically found in Canada: orange squash, ginger beer, Theakston’s Old Peculier, real bitter, etc. What is Carabao? What does it taste like? And, perhaps most important, what are the cultural assumptions British people make about Carabao drinkers? I’m old enough to know that no seemingly benign refreshment decision in the UK is made without social consequences.With Enciso on the bench, Arsenal will win. It’s too bad for Ipswich’s lack of courage. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Ed Aarons reports from Portman Road, with plenty of praise for Arsenal’s youngsters. That’s all from me. Thanks for reading!
A very happy night for Arsenal fans.
It goes down as Max Dowman’s night. Noni Madueke was dangerous, too, skipping down the right, and Ipswich never really threatened to do something special.
Arteta’s men progress. A tidy night, even with those two Ipswich goals in the second half.
Davis sends in a low cross from the left, Akpom collects, turns and shoots, and adds some respectability to the scoreline.
A goal against his former club!
90 min: Just two extra minutes added on.
88 min: Alan Baverstock writes in.
double quotation markDowman is definitely in the England team for the next World Cup isn’t he? Who else from the next generation?
He’ll be 20 – ancient – at the next World Cup.
87 min: Salmon intercepts by the halfway line and is taken down by Núñez, who goes in the book.
85 min: Ife Ibrahim is on for Arsenal, replacing Zubimendi. Ødegaard sends in a corner, punched by Walton.
84 min: Arsenal give the possession stats a boost.
81 min: There’s a handball shout inside the Arsenal area … but the ref blows for offside.
80 min: The game turns end-to-end, with Walton saving from Tzolis before Clarke very nearly has a chance to shoot for Ipswich.
77 min: Ipswich only started to play in the first half after going 2-0 down. It’s been a similar story this half, two more conceded before rediscovering some intensity.
76 min: Eze and the impressive Madueke go off. Ødegaard and Tzolis come on.
74 min: Gyökeres’ difficult game continues, unable to take control of the ball as Arsenal break … Ipswich respond with a shot on target, Arrizabalaga getting low to his right to hold on.
73 min: Eze twists and turns on the left and tries a cross/shot that travels wide.
72 min: Julienne overcooks a ball directed towards Lewis-Skelly, who drifts inside the area.
70 min: Leif Davis is on for Ipswich … and he whips in a delicious cross from the left. Arrizabalaga does well to collect cleanly.
68 min: Akpom, who started his career at Arsenal, finds the sidenetting with a cross.
65 min: Theo Julienne, 18 years old, is on for Guimarães.

Clarke, replacing Philogene on the left for Ipswich, drives down the wing and cuts back for Mehmeti, who finds the bottom corner to give Ipswich fans something to shout about. Or to set up the greatest comeback in Carabao history.
Instant impact from Clarke!
61 min: Ipswich make changes, with Chuba Akpom and Jack Clarke sent on.
Merino collects on the edge of the area and has enough space to curl in with his left foot. Clinical.
And another.
57 min: Arsenal continue to dominate the ball.

54 min: The corner is worked short … and the ball eventually finds Madueke inside the area, an excellent first touch setting him up for an effort … he pokes it across goal instead, perhaps hoping to find Gyökeres, but it escapes the centre-forward.
53 min: Madueke takes on Ouattara, who times his challenge well, leading to an Arsenal corner.
52 min: Arsenal knock it around at the back.
50 min: Flemming fights for the ball out on Ipswich’s left, gets a decent cross in … but he needs to be in the middle, too. Arrizabalaga collects.

Madueke pokes the ball through to Zubimendi inside the area, and he finds Dowman on the right-hand side. He calmly slots in once again – there’s a shout for an Ipswich handball in there, but the 16-year-old’s finish makes it irrelevant.
That’ll wrap it up.
46 min: We go again, with Arsenal on the ball and Lewis-Skelly drifting from left-back into midfield.
A change from Arsenal: Ezri Konsa replaces Gabriel.
Arsenal have had moments where they’ve been a bit open, particularly down the Ipswich left, where Zubimendi is filling in. But Gabriel has been typically solid, nipping in to sort any issues.
Kári Tulinius writes in:
double quotation markThe way Max Dowman cut through the Ipswich defense it was as if he was a 26-year-old playing against 16-year-olds.
A fairly smooth half for the Premier League champions.
45 min: We’ll have an extra minute.
43 min: Ipswich have been much better since going two-down but … well, they’re two-down.
41 min: Guimarães very nearly sneaks a ball to Eze inside the area, but it’s cut out by a blue shirt.
40 min: Mehmeti finds the ball on the left for Ipswich as they break, just Gabriel ahead of him … but it’s Gabriel. He doesn’t dive in, keeping Mehmeti quiet while Arsenal retreat.
37 min: Philogene, on Ipswich’s left, goes around the outside, into the area, leaving Salmon on the floor … but Arrizabalaga gets in the way of his cutback.
36 min: Gyökeres has had a quiet half.
35 min: Eze cuts in from the left … and has his shot blocked.
34 min: Merino gives away the ball in midfield and Ipswich win a corner … Núñez sends it into the front post, it’s flicked into a dangerous area … but Gabriel, once again, is there to save Arsenal.
32 min: Salmon slips up for Arsenal and Ipswich break forward … but Gabriel, the senior man at the back, slides in to clean up inside his area.

对于阿森纳球迷来说这是一个非常快乐的夜晚。
这个夜晚属于马克斯·道曼。马杜埃凯在右路的突破也极具威胁，伊普斯维奇从未真正构成实质威胁。
阿尔特塔的球队晋级了。这是一场轻松的比赛，尽管下半场丢了两个球。
戴维斯从左路送出低平球传中，阿克蓬接球转身射门，为球队挽回了一些颜面。
攻破老东家球门！
第90分钟：仅补时两分钟。
第88分钟：阿兰·巴弗斯特罗姆来信称。
道曼肯定能入选下一届世界杯的英格兰队吧？还有哪位是下一代新星？
到下一届世界杯时他才20岁——还很年轻。
第87分钟：萨尔蒙在半场附近拦截，被努涅斯犯规放倒，后者吃到黄牌。
第85分钟：伊费·易卜拉欣替补登场为阿森纳出场，换下祖比门迪。厄德高罚出角球，沃尔顿将球击出。
第84分钟：阿森纳进一步提升了控球率数据。
第81分钟：阿森纳禁区内疑似有手球……但裁判吹越位在先。
第80分钟：比赛进入对攻战，沃尔顿扑出了齐奥利斯的射门，随后克拉克险些为伊普斯维奇获得射门机会。
第77分钟：伊普斯维奇在上半场落后两球后才开始进入状态。下半场也是如此，在找回强度之前又丢了两球。
第76分钟：埃泽和表现出色的马杜埃凯离场。厄德高和齐奥利斯替补登场。
第74分钟：哲凯赖什表现艰难，在阿森纳反击时无法控制住球……伊普斯维奇随后回敬一脚射门，阿里萨巴拉加倒地将球按在身下。
第73分钟：埃泽在左路连续盘带后尝试传中兼射门，皮球偏出。
第72分钟：于连传球过大，未能给到插向禁区内的刘易斯-斯凯利。
第70分钟：利夫·戴维斯替补登场为伊普斯维奇出战……他从左路送出一脚精妙传中。阿里萨巴拉加稳稳将球摘下。
第68分钟：职业生涯出道于阿森纳的阿克蓬传中击中边网。
第65分钟：18岁的特奥·于连替补登场换下吉马良斯。
替补登场的克拉克在伊普斯维奇左路突破吉马良斯后横传，梅梅蒂推射远角得手，为主场球迷带来了欢呼的理由，也为他们保留了创造联赛杯历史最大翻盘的希望。
克拉克替补登场即建功！
第61分钟：伊普斯维奇进行换人调整，丘巴·阿克蓬和杰克·克拉克替补登场。
梅里诺在禁区边缘得球，获得足够的空间后用左脚兜射破门。极其冷酷。
再进一球。
第57分钟：阿森纳继续掌控球权。
第54分钟：角球短传配合……皮球最终传到禁区内的马杜埃凯脚下，他极佳的第一触球调整好步点……但他没有选择射门，而是将球横扫门前，或许是希望找到哲凯赖什，但球滑门而过。
第53分钟：马杜埃凯对位瓦塔拉，后者防守时机掌握得很好，为阿森纳赢得一个角球。
第52分钟：阿森纳在后场倒脚。
第50分钟：弗莱明在伊普斯维奇左路拼抢得球，送出一脚不错的传中……但他自己也需要赶到中路接应。阿里萨巴拉加将球没收。
马杜埃凯将球捅给禁区内的祖比门迪，后者顺势分给右路的道曼。他从容冷静地再次推射破门——虽然伊普斯维奇球员投诉有手球嫌疑，但这名16岁小将的射门让这一切变得不再重要。
这球锁定了胜局。
第46分钟：下半场比赛开始，阿森纳控球，刘易斯-斯凯利从左后卫位置游弋到中场。
阿森纳做出换人调整：埃兹里·孔萨替换加布里埃尔。
阿森纳有过防守空虚的时刻，特别是在伊普斯维奇的左路，祖比门迪在那里补防。但加布里埃尔一如既往地稳健，及时上抢化解了险情。
卡里·图利尼乌斯来信称：
马森·道曼切入伊普斯维奇防线的方式，就像是一个26岁的成年人在踢16岁小孩。
对于英超冠军来说，这是一个相当顺利的上半场。
第45分钟：上半场将补时一分钟。
第43分钟：伊普斯维奇在两球落后之后表现好了很多，但……毕竟他们已经落后两球了。
第41分钟：吉马良斯险些将球塞给禁区内的埃泽，但被身穿蓝衣的防守球员截断。
第40分钟：梅梅蒂在伊普斯维奇反击中在左路得球，前方只有加布里埃尔……但他可是加布里埃尔。他没有贸然上抢，而是压制住梅梅蒂的突破，同时等待阿森纳全队回防。
第37分钟：伊普斯维奇左路的菲洛根内带球内切杀入禁区，晃倒了萨尔蒙……但阿里萨巴拉加封堵了对方的倒三角回传。
第36分钟：哲凯赖什在上半场存在感不强。
第35分钟：埃泽从左路内切……但射门被封堵。
第34分钟：梅里诺在中场丢球，伊普斯维奇赢得角球……努涅斯将球传向近门柱，皮球被蹭到危险区域……但加布里埃尔再次挺身而出拯救了阿森纳。
第32分钟：萨尔蒙防守失误导致阿森纳防线被反击突破……但后防老将加布里埃尔滑铲将禁区内的险情化解。

bodyEn: The bad news for everyone else is that Arsenal’s next generation is already here. Two mesmerising goals and an assist in a man-of-the-match display from Max Dowman underlined why the 16-year-old has been compared to a certain Lionel Messi by his manager, Mikel Arteta, as Ipswich were swatted aside with ease. Almost as impressive was the performance of the 17-year-old Marli Salmon, who oozed class in central defence on only the second senior start of his career.

Ipswich won here the last time these two sides met in this competition, in 2011, but were beaten 3-0 in the second leg of the semi-final at the Emirates before Arsenal infam­ously lost to Birmingham in the final. ­Fifteen years on, Gary O’Neil’s heavily rotated side stood no chance against last year’s runners up after Dowman’s brilliant opening goal. Noni Madueke and the stand-in skipper Mikel Merino were also on target as Arsenal made it seven wins out of seven to start the new campaign. Having finally ended their long wait for silverware in style, this team are hungry for more and know they can now rely on one of the most exciting talents ever to have emerged from their Hale End academy.

“He can deliver those actions effortlessly. That’s his biggest quality,” said Arteta of the delightful shimmy that preceded Dowman’s first goal. “It’s a joy to have him. But what we have to do is look after him. He’s 16 years old, you don’t see that in this league. In other leagues in Europe, that’s a totally different context. We really need to make sure every time we throw him in, he’s in the right context with the right ­preparation. That’s what we are ­trying to do.”

Both managers made their prior­ities clear as there were a combined 19 changes from their sides’ wins in the Premier League at the weekend. After a summer of heavy spending, many of those who helped Ipswich bounce straight back from the Championship last season were given an opportunity to stake a claim but largely failed to do so. “It’s the most extreme test that you can face,” admitted O’Neil. “Every time we made a mistake we were punished.”

Dowman’s most recent first-team appearance was in the final game of last season when Arsenal were crowned champions, and he has since completed his GCSEs before spending a week in New York during the World Cup where he rubbed shoulders with Paul Pogba.

Arteta said beforehand he would have “earn his minutes” like anyone else and it only took seven of them for Dowman to seize his opportunity. Ipswich’s fans were taunting their Arsenal counterparts about never being crowned European champions when he muscled Santiago Núñez off the ball on the halfway line and set off towards the penalty area. The imposing figure of Cédric Kipré – all 6ft 3in of him – was all that stood in Dowman’s way but he went past the Ivory Coast defender in a flurry of feet before cooly dispatching a shot into the corner and performing a Thierry Henry knee slide for good measure.

Peterborough moved into the fourth round of the Carabao Cup for the first time since 2009 thanks to a 7-6 penalty shootout victory over Barnsley that followed a thrilling 3-3 draw between the two League One sides.

Barnsley were handed the lead after 61 seconds when a clearance by the Peterborough goalkeeper, Alex Bass, was charged down by Cameron McGeehan, with the Tykes captain nodding in after the ball had come off the bar.
Peterborough equalised in the 19th minute when Lucca Mendonca’s cross was pushed out by the Barnsley goalkeeper, Kieran Flavell, as far as Harry Leonard, who prodded in.

The hosts then completed the turnaround after 27 minutes when Harley Mills’ free-kick was headed in by the unmarked Danny Ormerod. But the Tykes were level five minutes before half-time when Reyes Cleary beat Mendonca with ease down the left before placing his shot into the bottom corner.
The visitors looked to have won it when Cleary bent in his second in the 74th minute, but Ormerod sent the tie to penalties with by heading in Mills’ cross with just two minutes remaining.
After 12 successful spot-kicks, a tame effort from Barnsley’s Luke Alker was saved by Bass, giving Harrison Jones the chance to send the hosts through, which he dispatched.

Brentford emerged from a tense finish against Reading to book their place in the Carabao Cup fourth round with a 2-1 victory. Callum Wilson and Fabio Carvalho were on target in the first half as the Premier League club showed a clinical touch against League One opposition, who produced a number of chances but lacked the firepower to finish them off. Paudie O’Connor eventually pulled one back to revive Reading’s challenge and Brentford could not rest easy in the remaining 18 minutes, although the substitute Igor Thiago was among those who should have killed the match off. Press Association

Ipswich’s mission got even harder when Madueke hammered in after Bruno Guimarães and Merino had combined to set him up after Dowman had started the press. Barely a quarter of an hour had been played. To their credit, the hosts rallied and it needed a clearance off the line from Salmon to deny Zian Flemming. Not to be outdone by Dowman, Salmon – who signed his professional contact when he turned 17 last month having also played in the Champions League and FA Cup last season – set out on a slaloming run just before half-time after calmly turning his way out of trouble under pressure from Flemming, drawing a round of applause from the Arsenal bench.

Ipswich’s hopes of mounting a comeback were extinguished within two minutes of the restart when Dowman struck again. Martín Zubimendi’s pass found him on the edge of the six-yard box and the finish was caressed into the far corner. Merino then curled home off the post from Dowman’s touch to put the result beyond any doubt, although the biggest roar of the evening came when Ipswich hit back through Anis Mehmeti after he was set up by the substitute Jack Clarke.

Including Myles Lewis-Skelly – a relative veteran these days at 19 and surely in line for an England recall this week after an excellent start to the season – Arsenal had four teenagers on the pitch at the end after the 18-year-old Theo Julienne came on at right-back. Even Ipswich had a Hale End grad­uate in their ranks by then as Chuba Akpom grabbed another consolation in injury time via a deflection. But, not for the last time one suspects, it was Dowman’s name that was on everyone’s lips at the end.

items.titleZh: 麦克斯·道曼独中两元助阿森纳替补阵容在联赛杯中击败伊普斯维奇
items.summaryZh: 16岁的道曼在联赛杯中奉献两球一助攻，帮助阿森纳轻松击败伊普斯维奇晋级。
bodyZh: 对其他人来说，坏消息是阿森纳的新生代已经到来。16岁的麦克斯·道曼在比赛中上演了全场最佳表现，奉献了两粒精彩的进球和一次助攻，这也印证了为什么主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔将这位年轻人与某位莱昂内尔·梅西相提并论，伊普斯维奇最终被轻松轻取。同样令人印象深刻的是17岁球员马利·萨尔蒙的表现，他在职业生涯仅有的第二次一线队首发出场中，在中央防守位置上展现出了极高的水准。

这两支球队上一次在该项赛事中相遇是在2011年，当时伊普斯维奇在这里取胜，但在酋长球场的半决赛次回合中以0比3失利，随后阿森纳在决赛中遗憾不敌伯明翰。十五年后，加里·奥尼尔大幅轮换的阵容在面对去年的亚军时毫无胜算，道曼打入了精彩的远射首开纪录。诺尼·马杜埃凯和代理队长米克尔·梅里诺也分别建功，阿森纳在新赛季开局取得了七连胜。在终于如愿以偿结束了长时间的冠军荒后，这支球队对更多荣誉充满渴望，并且深知他们现在可以依仗青训营中涌现出的最令人兴奋的天才之一。
“他能够毫不费力地完成这些动作。这是他最大的特点，”阿尔特塔谈到道曼第一球前那次精彩的晃动时说道。“拥有他是种快乐。但我们要做的就是保护他。他只有16岁，你在英超联赛中看不到这样的情况。在欧洲其他联赛，那是完全不同的环境。我们真的需要确保每次派他上场时，他都处于正确的环境并做好了充分的准备。这正是我们努力在做的。”
双方主教练都明确了各自的优先级，因为两队在周末英超联赛取胜的基础上总共作出了19处人员调整。经过一个夏天的巨额引援，许多帮助伊普斯维奇在上赛季直接从英冠升级的球员得到了证明自己的机会，但大多未能把握住。“这是你可能面临的最极端考验，”奥尼尔承认道。“我们每一次犯错都受到了惩罚。”
道曼上一次代表一线队出场是在上赛季阿森纳加冕冠军的最后一轮比赛中，自那以后他完成了普通中等教育证书考试（GCSEs），随后在世界杯期间前往纽约度过了一周，在那里与保罗·博格巴有过接触。
阿尔特塔赛前表示，他需要像其他人一样“挣得出场时间”，而道曼只用了七分钟就抓住了机会。当他在中场线从圣地亚哥·努涅斯脚下抢断并向禁区挺进时，伊普斯维奇球迷还在嘲笑阿森纳从未加冕欧洲冠军。身材高大的塞德里克·基普雷身高6英尺3英寸，是他面前唯一的障碍，但道曼在一阵眼花缭乱的脚法中晃过了这位科特迪瓦后卫，随后冷静地将球送入死角，并顺势模仿蒂埃里·亨利来了一次滑跪庆祝。
皮特堡联队凭借在点球大战中7比6战胜巴恩斯利，自2009年以来首次闯入联赛杯第四轮，此前两支英甲球队在常规时间战成3比3平。
巴恩斯利在比赛开始61秒后取得领先，当时皮特堡联队门将亚历克斯·巴斯的解围被卡梅伦·麦吉汉挡出，皮球击中横梁后由泰克斯队队长头球补射破门。
皮特堡联队在第19分钟扳平比分，卢卡·门多萨的传中被巴恩斯利门将基兰·弗拉维尔扑出，哈里·莱昂纳德补射得手。
主队随后在第27分钟完成反超，哈利·米尔斯的任意球被无人盯防的丹尼·奥尔默罗头球顶进。但客队在半场结束前五分钟将比分扳平，雷耶斯·克利里在左路轻松过掉门多萨后将球射入底角。
当克利里在第74分钟兜射攻入个人第二球时，客队看似已经锁定胜局，但奥尔默罗在比赛还剩两分钟时接米尔斯传中头球破门，将比赛拖入点球大战。
在12次成功的点球之后，巴恩斯利球员卢克·阿尔克的绵软射门被巴斯扑出，给了哈里森·琼斯为主队罚进制胜点球的机会，他稳稳罚中。
布伦特福德在与雷丁的紧张对决中以2比1取胜，锁定了联赛杯第四轮的席位。卡勒姆·威尔逊和法比奥·卡瓦略在上半场建功，展现了这支英超球队面对英甲对手时的门前效率，客队虽然创造了不少机会但缺乏终结能力。保迪·奥康纳随后为雷丁扳回一城重燃希望，布伦特福德在剩下的18分钟里不敢松懈，尽管替补出场的伊戈尔·蒂亚戈本有机会杀死比赛悬念。美联社
伊普斯维奇的任务变得更加艰巨，在道曼发动前场逼抢后，布鲁诺·吉马良斯和梅里诺联手助攻马杜埃凯轰门得手。当时比赛才进行了刚刚过一刻钟。值得赞赏的是，主队随后发起反扑，萨尔蒙门线解围挡出了齐安·弗莱明的射门。萨尔蒙上个月年满17岁时签署了职业合同，上赛季还在欧冠和足总杯中有过登场，他不甘示弱，在半场结束前面对弗莱明的紧逼冷静摆脱困境后开始了一次长途奔袭，赢得了阿森纳替补席的一片掌声。
订阅每日足球
开启卫报对世界足球视角的晚间新闻
在新闻简报推广之后
伊普斯维奇逆转的希望在下半场开始两分钟后彻底破灭，当时道曼再次破门。马丁·祖比门迪的传球找到了小禁区边缘的他，他将球轻巧地推入远角。随后梅里诺接道曼的传球在门柱边兜射破门，彻底锁定了胜局，不过全场最大的欢呼声来自于伊普斯维奇由替补出场的杰克·克拉克助攻阿尼斯·穆罕默迪扳回一城时。
算上迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利——如今19岁的他已算是一名“老将”，且凭借出色的赛季开局本周有望重新入选英格兰代表团——阿森纳在比赛结束时场上有四名青少年球员，此前18岁的特奥·于利安替补登场司职右后卫。甚至连伊普斯维奇阵中当时也有了一位黑尔恩德青训毕业生，丘巴·阿克庞在补时阶段通过折射打入了一粒安慰奖性质的进球。不过，人们在终场时议论纷纷的名字依然是道曼，这恐怕不会是最后一次。
